newsitem.title: DENMARK: Peter Straarup named new Danske Bank CEO.
newsitem.headline: Peter Straarup named new Danske Bank CEO.

text.p: Den Danske Bank, Denmark's biggest bank, on Thursday appointed Peter Straarup to succeed chief executive Knud Soerensen, who retires from the post at end-March 1998.
Straarup, 45, a former director of Den Danske branches in Singapore and New York and member of the bank's executive board since 1986, takes up his post next April 1, the bank said in statement.
Soerensen, 62, has been Den Danske's CEO since 1990, Straarup has been deputy chairman of the executive board since last year. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
